actions.script: // a message the user may not see is "not found": the screen says so rather than failing ec.message.pushErrors() try { const detailOut = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.run#Operation').parameters({operation: 'get#MessageDetail', parameters: {emailMessageId: emailMessageId || null, communicationEventId: communicationEventId || null}}).requireNewTransaction(true).call()?.result || {} detail = ec.message.hasError() ? null : (detailOut?.detail || null) } finally { ec.message.clearErrors(); ec.message.popErrors() } notFound = detail == null const fmt = (millis) => millis ? ec.l10n.format(new Date(Number(millis)), 'EEE, MMM d, yyyy h:mm a') : '' dateText = detail ? fmt(detail.dateMillis) : '' inboxUrl = detail && detail.threadKey ? '/qapps/' + (appRoot || 'BasicComms') + '/Inbox?view=all&thread=' + encodeURIComponent(detail.threadKey) : null replyUrl = detail ? (detail.kind === 'email' && detail.emailMessageId ? '/qapps/' + (appRoot || 'BasicComms') + '/Inbox/Compose?replyToEmailMessageId=' + encodeURIComponent(detail.emailMessageId) : (detail.communicationEventId ? '/qapps/' + (appRoot || 'BasicComms') + '/Inbox/Compose?replyToCommEventId=' + encodeURIComponent(detail.communicationEventId) : null)) : null emlUrl = detail && detail.kind === 'email' ? '/apps/Comms/Inbox/MessageDetail/downloadEml?emailMessageId=' + encodeURIComponent(detail.emailMessageId) : null printUrl = detail ? '/apps/Comms/Inbox/MessageDetail?renderMode=html-print&' + (detail.emailMessageId ? 'emailMessageId=' + encodeURIComponent(detail.emailMessageId) : 'communicationEventId=' + encodeURIComponent(detail.communicationEventId)) : null statusColor = !detail ? 'grey-7' : (/BOUNCED|CANCEL/.test(detail.statusId || '') ? 'negative' : (/SENT|RECEIVED|VIEWED/.test(detail.statusId || '') ? 'info' : (detail.statusId === 'ES_DRAFT' ? 'grey-7' : 'primary'))) statusHtml = String((detail && detail.statusText) || '').replace(/[<>&"]/g, (ch) => ({'<': '<', '>': '>', '&': '&', '"': '"'})[ch]) fileList = detail ? detail.attachmentList : [] commEventList = detail ? detail.commEventList : [] linkList = detail ? detail.linkList : [] sourceText = detail ? [detail.headersText || '', '', detail.text || detail.html || ''].join('\n') : ''
